records.claim_text: The ACCA educational article distinguishes future decision-caused cash changes from already incurred or unavoidable commitments and unchanged overhead allocations. Its labour example distinguishes already-paid available hours, extra labour and displaced work.
records.population: Illustrative short-term financial decision examples, not empirical payroll employer evidence
records.limitations: Educational examples, not payroll staffing requirement or employer convention. No numerical examples or salary/opportunity-cost formula transferred. Article cash lens does not establish free resources, negligible nonfinancial effects or disappearance of existing funding obligations.
records.review_mode: Relevant live original HTML inspected and retained; no employer test, costing model or numerical example adopted
records.time_period: Educational concept, accessed29October2026; no observed trend
